products.name: Bardeen
products.note: Browser automation AI; web scraping; personal productivity; data exposure risk

profile_text.body:
Bardeen is an automation and workflow platform aimed at go-to-market teams. The company describes itself as helping such teams eliminate manual tasks, automate repetitive workflows, manage data across systems, and connect with a range of third-party tools. Its stated focus is on sourcing and qualifying sales leads at scale.

The core product, also called Bardeen, is a browser-based automation tool that combines an agentic web scraper with AI-assisted lead qualification and contact enrichment. The platform draws on web search providers and AI to research or generate leads and to surface answers directly from websites. The held facts categorize it under automation and agents, and note associated considerations around data exposure risk.

No litigation, MCP server listings, SEC filings, or patent records appear in the available data.
